channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Mozilla Corporation (mozilla).

item.title: CVE-2026-92240 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Out-of-bounds read in IMAP response parser
item.description: A malicious or compromised IMAP server can trigger an out-of-bounds read in the IMAP response parser by sending an untagged '* ID' response, crashing Thunderbird. The affected parsing path is reachable before authentication. This vulnerability was fi…

item.title: CVE-2026-92239 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — Buffer overrun in IMAP
item.description: A maliciously constructed IMAP line could cause an out-of-bounds buffer read. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 156, Thunderbird 140.16, and Thunderbird 153.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-92238 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Ambiguous parsing of mail headers
item.description: A maliciously constructed mail header could lead to multiple fields being parsed as one, or potential memory safety violations. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 156, Thunderbird 140.16, and Thunderbird 153.3.
